2.name: Aethan Estate

effects.text: When you purge this card, you may save 1 other card from being purged.

2.text: {triggeredForced} When you purge this card, you may save 1 other card from being purged.
2.helpText:
Remember that when you purge cards, you select the cards first, putting them aside. When all cards are selected, you purge them (sum up their [vp] and write it in sticker 16, which is then placed on the side of your box). It is after you have selected all cards that you may use this effect, if this is one of the selected cards for this purge.

NOTE: If you prevent this card from being purged, you DO NOT get its effect.
